title: Rutas
description: Cada línea frente a las demás: puntualidad, cumplimiento, retraso y distancia.

list.name: route
list.label: Línea
list.query: SELECT route_code FROM kpi_routes WHERE active ORDER BY 1

list.name: bus
list.label: Bus
list.query: SELECT bus FROM (SELECT bus FROM kpi_trips UNION SELECT bus FROM kpi_alerts) b ORDER BY 1

list.name: scope
list.label: Datos
list.query: Reales y simulados : all, Solo reales : real, Solo simulados : simulated

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_code AS "Línea",
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'late') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Puntualidad"
        FROM kpi_trip_stops WHERE $__timeFilter(starts_at) AND trip_state IN ('done', 'incomplete') AND route_code IN ($route) AND bus IN ($bus) AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR ('$scope' = 'real' AND NOT simulated) OR ('$scope' = 'simulated' AND simulated)) AND actual_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT route_code AS "Línea",
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'done') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Cumplimiento"
        FROM kpi_trips WHERE $__timeFilter(starts_at) AND state IN ('done', 'incomplete') AND route_code IN ($route) AND bus IN ($bus) AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR ('$scope' = 'real' AND NOT simulated) OR ('$scope' = 'simulated' AND simulated)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT route_code AS "Línea",
        AVG(delay_min) AS "Retraso" FROM kpi_trip_stops WHERE $__timeFilter(starts_at) AND trip_state IN ('done', 'incomplete') AND route_code IN ($route) AND bus IN ($bus) AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR ('$scope' = 'real' AND NOT simulated) OR ('$scope' = 'simulated' AND simulated)) AND status = 'late' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Distancia estimada y recorrida por línea (km)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_code AS "Línea",
        SUM(distance_est_km) AS "Estimada", SUM(distance_real_km) AS "Recorrida"
        FROM kpi_trips WHERE $__timeFilter(starts_at) AND state IN ('done', 'incomplete') AND route_code IN ($route) AND bus IN ($bus) AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR ('$scope' = 'real' AND NOT simulated) OR ('$scope' = 'simulated' AND simulated)) AND distance_real_km > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(route_code, 'Sin línea') AS "Línea", COUNT(*) AS "Alertas"
        FROM kpi_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(happened_at) AND (route_code IN ($route) OR route_code IS NULL) AND bus IN ($bus) AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR ('$scope' = 'real' AND NOT simulated) OR ('$scope' = 'simulated' AND simulated)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH trips AS (
            SELECT route_code, COUNT(*) AS trips, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'done') / COUNT(*) AS compliance,
                   COALESCE(SUM(distance_est_km) FILTER (WHERE distance_real_km > 0), 0) AS est_km,
                   COALESCE(SUM(distance_real_km), 0) AS real_km
              FROM kpi_trips WHERE $__timeFilter(starts_at) AND state IN ('done', 'incomplete') AND route_code IN ($route) AND bus IN ($bus) AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR ('$scope' = 'real' AND NOT simulated) OR ('$scope' = 'simulated' AND simulated)) GROUP BY 1
        ), stops AS (
            SELECT route_code, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'late') / COUNT(*) AS punctuality,
                   AVG(delay_min) FILTER (WHERE status = 'late') AS delay
              FROM kpi_trip_stops WHERE $__timeFilter(starts_at) AND trip_state IN ('done', 'incomplete') AND route_code IN ($route) AND bus IN ($bus) AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR ('$scope' = 'real' AND NOT simulated) OR ('$scope' = 'simulated' AND simulated)) AND actual_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1
        ), alerts AS (
            SELECT route_code, COUNT(*) AS alerts FROM kpi_alerts WHERE $__timeFilter(happened_at) AND (route_code IN ($route) OR route_code IS NULL) AND bus IN ($bus) AND ('$scope' = 'all' OR ('$scope' = 'real' AND NOT simulated) OR ('$scope' = 'simulated' AND simulated)) GROUP BY 1
        )
        SELECT r.route_code AS "Línea", r.route_name AS "Nombre", COALESCE(trips.trips, 0) AS "Recorridos",
               ROUND(trips.compliance::numeric, 1) AS "Cumplimiento %", ROUND(stops.punctuality::numeric, 1) AS "Puntualidad %",
               ROUND(stops.delay::numeric, 1) AS "Retraso prom. (min)", ROUND(trips.est_km::numeric, 1) AS "Km estimados",
               ROUND(trips.real_km::numeric, 1) AS "Km recorridos", COALESCE(alerts.alerts, 0) AS "Alertas"
          FROM kpi_routes r LEFT JOIN trips USING (route_code) LEFT JOIN stops USING (route_code)
          LEFT JOIN alerts USING (route_code) WHERE r.active AND r.route_code IN ($route) ORDER BY 1
